reviewer: Coding-session independent content inspection, not a model self-review or external practitioner audit

findings.finding: Gross revenue is declared with variable_service_cost already deducted. Partner charges are declared already deducted but omitted from deducted_costs. The canonical validator rejects the original unmodified plan.

The selected contribution_margin purpose is paired with revenue minus cost. That calculates an amount, not a margin; the valid ratio would require contribution profit and recognized revenue. No observed values are available.
Paasa IFSC Private Limited is selected without confirming the investment entity or the advisory service relationship. Sources name multiple entities and leave investment identity unresolved.

A billing ledger does not alone establish recognized revenue, partner pass-throughs and retained revenue. Per-trade brokerage/API logs omit the broader managed-advisory and support cost allocation needed for the proposed contribution question.

A cohort_rate uses compare instead of divide; successful transfers are denominated in transactions while eligible accounts are denominated in customers. The count inputs incorrectly use flow and point_stock rather than compatible observation windows.

Transfer execution does not establish resolution of customer-reported remittance friction. The proposed records do not measure the claimed problem-resolution outcome, nor link unique eligible customers to matching event windows.

Paasa, Inc. is selected without confirming the investment entity. A rolling new-customer quarter with a generic equal-exposure label does not define mature cohort eligibility or customer-relative follow-up.
